mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_addresses(customer_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default) VALUES(#{customerId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_addresses SET recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault} WHERE address_id = #{addressId}
UPDATE customer_addresses SET is_default = CASE WHEN address_id = #{addressId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
UPDATE customer_addresses SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_default = TRUE
